sourceData.meaningMnemonic: The radical and the kanji for <kanji>father</kanji> are the same.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: Imagine your father is <reading>Cheech</reading> (<ja>ちち</ja>) from Cheech and Chong.
sourceData.meaningInfo: No, I am not your father... but this kanji / radical set is!
sourceData.readingInfo: Hopefully you know who they are. If not, think about your father laughing like this: <ja>ちちちちちちちち〜！</ja>
